mapper.select: SELECT wm.* FROM wms_measure wm INNER JOIN wms_classification wc ON wc.id = wm.classification_id WHERE wc.bool_last_enum = 1 AND wc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wm.measure_unit IS NULL AND wm.measure_precision IS NULL AND wm.accounting_unit IS NULL AND wm.accounting_precision IS NULL;

SELECT * FROM wms_measure wm INNER JOIN wms_classification wc ON wc.id = wm.classification_id WHERE wc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ( wc.bool_last_enum = 1 AND wm.accounting_unit IS NULL AND wm.accounting_precision IS NULL AND wm.measure_unit IS NULL AND wm.measure_precision IS NULL AND FIND_IN_SET( #{classificationId}, wc.path ) AND wc.id != #{classificationId} ) OR (wm.use_parent_id = #{classificationId})
